name: paper-garden-line-to-bloom
title: Paper Garden: A Line Learns to Bloom
description: A graphite line becomes a folded stem, opens into a coral paper flower, and spreads into a small kinetic garden. Real 3D origami geometry meets camera-projected 2D crease lines and an original tactile score. Includes a Hyperframes media composition and editable Blender/Python sources. Native 1920×1080, 30fps, 20 seconds; prerendered 3D, not a live WebGL scene.
